name: Iris
source:
Shy and kind, Iris is from a species that often win humans over due to their cuteness. She's a living plant who feeds on water, sunlight and fruits/vegetables. Looking the most humanoid overall and being smaller than the others make her the easiest for [url=https://vndb.org/c69867]Morgan[/url] to talk to at first.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/812410/]Steam[/url]]
